facts.text: Tufts offers the 1-4-4 academic calendar format, which includes a flexible January term for intensive study or internships alongside two main semesters.

sources.title: Tufts University Academic Calendar
sources.quote: Tufts operates on a traditional two-semester system with an optional January term for concentrated coursework.
